tags.label: Rush
tags.summary: Tempo windows that amp allies for a short burst of aggression.

tags.label: Crit
tags.summary: Critical strikes and effects that trigger when attacks crit.

tags.label: Stall
tags.summary: Control and delay tools that interrupt enemy pace.

tags.label: Shield
tags.summary: Absorb damage with temporary shields before HP is touched.

tags.label: Burn
tags.summary: Damage-over-time fire stacks that punish packed enemies.

tags.label: Poison
tags.summary: Stacking toxin that drains enemies over time.

tags.label: Frost
tags.summary: Cold effects that slow, lock down, or set up bursts.

tags.label: Shard
tags.summary: Crystal charges spent or consumed for bonus effects.

tags.label: Stealth
tags.summary: Leave threat range briefly to reposition or guarantee a hit.

tags.label: Stun
tags.summary: Hard disable that stops enemy actions for a moment.

tags.label: Heal
tags.summary: Restore HP directly to keep the team in the fight.

tags.label: Omnivamp
tags.summary: Convert a portion of damage dealt into healing.

tags.label: Debuff
tags.summary: Negative status effects that weaken or disrupt enemies.

tags.label: Taunt
tags.summary: Force enemies to focus a target, usually the frontline.

tags.label: Warrior
tags.summary: Attack-focused fighters built around Crit, Rush, and Shields.

tags.label: Tank
tags.summary: Defense anchors that Stall, Poison, and Frost the battlefield.

tags.label: Vanguard
tags.summary: Max-HP bruisers leaning on Rush, Shields, and Burn.

tags.label: Assassin
tags.summary: Crit burst killers with Shards, Poison, Rush, and Stealth.

tags.label: Duelist
tags.summary: Attack-speed duelists mixing Stall, Rush, Debuffs, and Crit.

tags.label: Mystic
tags.summary: Mana-regen casters supporting with Shields, Shards, and Debuffs.

tags.label: Mage
tags.summary: Magic casters that Stall, Burn, and Frost through abilities.

tags.label: Attack
tags.summary: Physical attack power used by auto attacks and many actives.

tags.label: Defense
tags.summary: Damage reduction and tankiness for the frontline.

tags.label: Magic
tags.summary: Spell power that scales ability damage and disruptions.

tags.label: Max HP
tags.summary: Maximum health — key scaling for Vanguards and sustain comps.

tags.label: Attack Speed
tags.summary: How quickly auto attacks fire; central to Duelists.

tags.label: Mana Regen
tags.summary: Mana recovery that lets Mystics spam their active.
